company.role: Member of Technical Staff, Health Systems
company.heroLine: A small live demo I built for OpenEvidence.
company.disclaimer: Independent demo using public data. Not affiliated with OpenEvidence.
company.problem: Guidance changes fast. A boxed warning, a CDC report, or an FDA notice can land in the middle of a busy clinic week. The update sits in a label or a federal document, and a doctor can miss it.
company.solution: A daily pipeline pulls public updates, keeps the link to the original document, and codes a change to a condition or a drug only when a phrase map or a public drug code says so. The tiles use example targets I set for this demo.

goals.label: Sources refreshed today
goals.detail: Example target. Share of the four public sources that returned on this run.

goals.label: Hours to surface
goals.detail: Example target. Median hours from the publish date to the first fetch, for items published in the last 7 days. A daily job first sees older items in that window, so the median is often a few days. Lower is better.

goals.label: Coded to ICD-10 or RxNorm
goals.detail: Example target. Share of items with an ICD-10 phrase match or a confirmed RxNorm code.

goals.label: High-impact changes this week
goals.detail: Example target. Boxed warnings, CDC recommendations, Class I recalls, and FDA guidance notices published this week. Pace line is day 7 of 7.
